svg.metadata: {"id": "s093", "name": "沙漠绿洲", "cat": "自然与地理", "tags": ["科学", "地理", "水资源", "生态"], "desc": "金色沙漠：层层沙丘由远及近颜色渐深，骆驼商队走过沙脊，中间一汪碧蓝绿洲环绕椰枣树。", "stand": {"ground_y": 920, "x": [480, 1440]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "heat", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "dunes_far", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "caravan", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "dunes_mid", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "oasis", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "pool_shine", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "flow", "depth": null}, {"name": "palms", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.7, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "dunes_near", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "rocks", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "birds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "sand_drift", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "flow", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#8FCDE4", "sky2": "#FCE6C6", "sun": "#FFF0C4", "far": "#F4D2A8", "far2": "#EFC495", "mid": "#ECB27A", "mid2": "#D99A5E", "near": "#E3A066", "near2": "#C98048", "pool": "#3EB8C0", "pool2": "#9FE3E0", "reed": "#7BB85E", "palm": "#3E9A6A", "palm2": "#5DB57E", "trunk": "#A9764A", "trunk2": "#7E5432", "camel": "#B9763E", "camel2": "#8E5629", "rock": "#C98A5A", "rock2": "#E2AA78", "grass": "#8CC46A"}}
